notes.text: Design for approval only. Dense four-slide main presentation, with the complete system first and derivations last. No runtime files or M2a package changed. One Linux host. Lab is a project ownership boundary, not one container. M2a owns native research decisions, capsule compatibility/verification/history; manager owns environment lifecycle/routing. Host execution provider is a scoped infrastructure boundary, not a second research agent. Each concrete runtime resource has one controller. No host Docker socket in agent/capsule containers. Shared inference and immutable image library are not part of a lab writable layer. Manual merge only. Sources: docs/architecture/lab-manager/capsule-support.md, communication-adapter.md; in-progress library Designs/ai4r_m2a; October 30 user attachment. Runtime/provider compatibility and standalone invocation remain to qualify after approval. This is a logical ownership/system diagram on one machine. Blue is native research request/status; orange is host runtime control; purple is logical capsule invocation; green is source/state/image pins; cyan is inference; rose is selected export and human adoption. A cyan line has an intentional visual gap at the blue bus to indicate a crossing, not a junction. Native model client directly calls shared inference; requests do not go through the manager. Optional private model service belongs to a lab and stores mutable weights/checkpoints in its data. Top image-library arrow feeds pinned release identity to host provisioning. Manager includes scoped execution-provider functions logically; no new service is required. M2a guarded invocation/assessment details are on slide 2. Lab B research route follows the outer upper/right lane so it does not pass through Lab A.

notes.text: Design for approval only. Dense four-slide main presentation, with the complete system first and derivations last. No runtime files or M2a package changed. One Linux host. Lab is a project ownership boundary, not one container. M2a owns native research decisions, capsule compatibility/verification/history; manager owns environment lifecycle/routing. Host execution provider is a scoped infrastructure boundary, not a second research agent. Each concrete runtime resource has one controller. No host Docker socket in agent/capsule containers. Shared inference and immutable image library are not part of a lab writable layer. Manual merge only. Sources: docs/architecture/lab-manager/capsule-support.md, communication-adapter.md; in-progress library Designs/ai4r_m2a; October 30 user attachment. Runtime/provider compatibility and standalone invocation remain to qualify after approval. Capsule image is the immutable OCI carrier of related capabilities, declarations, guards/checkers, entrypoints, dependency pins and guidance. Actual checks remain required across CLI, Python and MCP. Native M2a selects/binds exact release, actual input/effect scope, providers and task obligations. Host provider launches or connects to declared job/service, enforces real mounts/network/resource effects and returns stable job identity/observations. Process success is not scientific acceptance; output checks and artifact release remain M2a. Mutable usage/trust history is outside the immutable image, keyed to release and environment. Detach stops future selection and drains/cancels/removes appropriate instances while retaining evidence and declared state. No global image prune or deletion of another lab dependencies. Candidate changes yield new images/releases; no mutation of admitted shared images. Services may be reused across calls; per-call checks persist. Independent task checking may add obligations beyond capsule-producer checks.

notes.text: Design for approval only. Dense four-slide main presentation, with the complete system first and derivations last. No runtime files or M2a package changed. One Linux host. Lab is a project ownership boundary, not one container. M2a owns native research decisions, capsule compatibility/verification/history; manager owns environment lifecycle/routing. Host execution provider is a scoped infrastructure boundary, not a second research agent. Each concrete runtime resource has one controller. No host Docker socket in agent/capsule containers. Shared inference and immutable image library are not part of a lab writable layer. Manual merge only. Sources: docs/architecture/lab-manager/capsule-support.md, communication-adapter.md; in-progress library Designs/ai4r_m2a; October 30 user attachment. Runtime/provider compatibility and standalone invocation remain to qualify after approval. This sequence is a conceptual cross-system view, not fixed research stages. M2a plans adaptively and can invoke further compatible capabilities from checked observations. Exact native client ID is persisted and looked up before native submission. Lost delivery is unknown, never a new research ID. A native no-allocation reply is authoritative only under a verified compatible authenticated API. Host job handles are distinct from native research run IDs. Host returns execution observations, not scientific verdicts. Native cancellation/checkpoint attempt precedes bounded runtime stop; force stop is explicit, archive preserves data. Export is human-selected and manually adopted (full topology slide 1). Model access is through existing abstraction, not through research relay.
